result.description: Compact external solid-state storage built for fast file transfers, everyday backups, and travel use. The Nebula Forge combines a USB 3.2 interface with a durable anodized shell and silent operation, making it a reliable option for creators, students, and on-the-go professionals. Includes 2TB of flash storage and plug-and-play compatibility across common desktop and laptop systems.
result.title: Nebula Forge 2TB Portable SSD Midnight
